functions.label: Care Coordination
functions.blurb: Keep everyone who helps on the same page — shared calendars, task lists, and one place for updates so you're not repeating yourself to five people.

functions.label: Medication & Health Tracking
functions.blurb: Dose reminders, refill alerts, and symptom logs you can hand to a doctor instead of trying to remember how the last three months went.

functions.label: Daily Routines & Behavior Support
functions.blurb: Help with the hard moments and the shape of the day — spotting what sets things off, and having a strategy ready before the next time.

functions.label: Communication (AAC)
functions.blurb: Augmentative and alternative communication — giving a voice to people with limited or no speech through symbols, text, and synthesized speech.

functions.label: Safety & Location
functions.blurb: Location sharing and alerts for peace of mind, especially when wandering or getting lost is a concern.

functions.label: Accessibility Mapping
functions.blurb: Find out whether a restaurant, park, or restroom is actually accessible before you load up the car.
